correctness.rationale: Exact symplectic intersection counts give four common eigenspaces, a complete q-polynomial eigenvalue table and orthogonality-based multiplicities. The only potentially nonnegative centered powered-distance eigenvalue is F2=-1+q²(3^p-2^p): F3 is strictly concave and negative throughout [0,1], including an explicit tangent bound for q=2, and F1<=F3. Unique root, Schoenberg equivalence, strict Gaussian positivity and endpoint embedding rank follow. The supplied checker independently constructs all 135 binary Lagrangians and confirms the integer intersection identities and predicted spectra.

value.rationale: Determines a canonical positive-definite-kernel/negative-type invariant of an entire unbounded family of homogeneous symplectic metric spaces. The exact field-dependent threshold and highly degenerate critical eigenspace give a sharp Euclidean embedding-dimension collapse from N-1 to q(q²+1)², with decay alpha_q~1/(q² log(3/2)). It is an intrinsic classification, not an arbitrary finite slice or mere known-table recomputation.
